column1: # Turkish glossary. CLAUDE-ONLY PROPOSAL (2026-11-05): drafted by one model, not judged by the council; nothing here is final.
# Term column: Turkish forms, separated by " | "; first form is the canonical one. Definitions carry D3's meanings (scratch/english-fixes/d3-*) and stay in English: they describe the en.tsv term.

# Matching: Turkish is suffixing, so a form matches at the start of a word (kilit also matches kilitli). Forms hold no apostrophe where the stem alone matches (gidon PIN matches gidon PIN’i). A form that starts with i or ı is listed in both cases, because the tools lower-case İ and I without Turkish rules.
# Forms may be bare stems where a word softens before an ending (yedeğ matches yedeği, yolculuğ matches yolculuğu).

# kilidi is deliberately not a form of lock: it appears only inside the unlock phrases. Only that spelling separates the two by itself; tools/l10n/lexicon.py reads the words after kilit (Kilit açık, Kilit açma, Kilitsiz).
# D3 merged with the English fixes (#208, 2026-11-05): the rows it retired are gone, the Eco and Turbo rows went with them (do-not-translate now), and its new rows have Claude's proposal too.
# The Top speed / Maximum speed hold is over: en.tsv and the strings now use D3's senses (Maximum speed is the setting, Top speed the measured value), matching the rows below.
# Rows en.tsv gained in the English fixes (#208) and the stop-the-scooter split of 2026-11-07, proposed by Claude on 2026-11-09 after they merged.
